name: Click Guide Visualizer
description: Shows you where the clicks are before you get to them.

issues.info: Report bugs on the GitHub issues page.

show-guide.name: Show The Guide
show-guide.description: Master switch. Turn this off to hide everything.

line-color.name: Main Colour
line-color.description: Colour of the bars and notes for player 1.

hold-color.name: Hold Colour
hold-color.description: Colour of the long bars you hold down for.

marker-color.name: Click Dot Colour
marker-color.description: Colour of the small dots that mark each click.

judgement-line-color.name: Hit Line Colour
judgement-line-color.description: Colour of the line you time your clicks against.

indicator-opacity.name: Note Fade
indicator-opacity.description: How see-through the notes and click dots are. Lower is fainter.

band-opacity.name: Bar Fade
band-opacity.description: How see-through the bars drawn in the level are.

fill-opacity.name: Inside Fade
fill-opacity.description: How see-through the inside of every shape is. The outlines stay.

hold-opacity.name: Hold Fade
hold-opacity.description: How see-through the long hold bars are. Nothing else changes.

show-player-line.name: Show Line At Player
show-player-line.description: Draw a line where your player is right now.

line-lead-units.name: Move Line Ahead
line-lead-units.description: Push the line this far in front of your player.

line-lead-seconds.name: Move Line Ahead (time)
line-lead-seconds.description: Push the line this many seconds in front of your player.

clip-bands-at-line.name: Cut Bars At The Line
clip-bands-at-line.description: Hide the part of each bar that is behind the line.

show-band-lines.name: Show Click Lines
show-band-lines.description: Draw a thin line inside each bar showing the exact click.

cull-padding.name: Draw Distance
cull-padding.description: How far off screen to keep drawing. Higher costs more performance.

show-accuracy.name: Show How Early Or Late
show-accuracy.description: Show a number after each click telling you how many frames off you were.

show-clicks.name: Show Click Dots
show-clicks.description: Show a dot at each click.

marker-row.name: Dot Height
marker-row.description: How high above the ground the dots sit.

marker-size.name: Click Dot Size
marker-size.description: How big the click dots are.

learn-trajectory.name: Learn From Your Runs
learn-trajectory.description: Remember where you actually were, so the guide lines up better next try.

predict-heights.name: Guess Your Height
predict-heights.description: Work out how high you will be at each click instead of using a fixed height.

show-path.name: Show Flight Path
show-path.description: Draw the line your player will follow. Needs Guess Your Height on.

show-wave-path.name: Show Wave Path
show-wave-path.description: Draw the exact line the wave takes from the macro, so you can see the whole zigzag before you reach it. Wave only.

rhythm-mode.name: Use Rhythm Mode
rhythm-mode.description: Show a falling note column in the middle of the screen instead of drawing on the level.

rhythm-hide-world-guide.name: Hide The Level Guide
rhythm-hide-world-guide.description: While rhythm mode is on, stop drawing bars on the level.

rhythm-lead-time.name: How Far Ahead
rhythm-lead-time.description: How many seconds of notes you can see. Lower means they fall faster.

rhythm-lane-x.name: Column Left Or Right
rhythm-lane-x.description: Where the column sits across the screen. 0.5 is the middle.

rhythm-hit-y.name: Hit Line Height
rhythm-hit-y.description: Where the line you aim for sits. 0.5 is the middle of the screen.

rhythm-note-thickness.name: Note Thickness
rhythm-note-thickness.description: How thick each note line is. Thin shows the exact click frame. Notes thin out on their own when clicks are close together.

rhythm-lane-opacity.name: Column Fade
rhythm-lane-opacity.description: How see-through the column background is.

rhythm-hit-effects.name: Hit Animation
rhythm-hit-effects.description: Play a burst when you click instead of the note just vanishing.

enable-cheats.name: Turn On Cheats
enable-cheats.description: Master switch for the cheat below. Off by default.

assist-buffer-input.name: Hold Early Clicks
assist-buffer-input.description: If you click early, wait and fire it on the right frame. This is a cheat.

assist-buffer-window.name: How Early To Allow
assist-buffer-window.description: The most time a click can be held for.

assist-show-window.name: Show The Window
assist-show-window.description: Shade the area where an early click will be held.

line-thickness.name: Player Line Thickness
line-thickness.description: How thick the line at your player is.

show-releases.name: Show Where To Let Go
show-releases.description: Mark where each hold ends, not just where it starts.

key-toggle.name: Turn The Guide On And Off
key-toggle.description: Flip the guide on or off without opening the menu.

key-prev-macro.name: Previous Macro
key-prev-macro.description: Switch to the macro before this one in your library.

key-next-macro.name: Next Macro
key-next-macro.description: Switch to the macro after this one in your library.

hotkey-popup-seconds.name: Popup Time
hotkey-popup-seconds.description: How long the macro name stays on screen after you switch.

online-browsing.name: Find Macros Online
online-browsing.description: Look up macros for the level you are playing from hyperbolus.net. Off by default. Turning this on contacts their server.

online-auto-open.name: Search When Menu Opens
online-auto-open.description: Automatically look for macros when you open the Click Guide menu, instead of pressing Online.

macro-file.name: Pick A Macro
macro-file.description: Choose a macro file to show. The pause menu button is usually easier.

auto-align.name: Line Up Automatically
auto-align.description: Work out on its own how far off the macro is and correct it.

auto-load-macro.name: Remember Last Macro
auto-load-macro.description: Load the macro you used last time when the game starts.

debug-log.name: Extra Logging
debug-log.description: Write more detail to the Geode log. For bug reports.
